task.title: Modifying the configuration file by using the CLI
task.shortdesc: To modify the config.yaml file for your Red Hat Quay registry and enable new features, you can download the existing configuration from the configBundleSecret by using the CLI. After making changes, you can re-upload the configBundleSecret resource to apply the changes.

ul.li: You are logged in to the OpenShift Container Platform cluster as a user with admin privileges.

note.p: Modifying the config.yaml file that is stored by the configBundleSecret resource is a multi-step procedure that requires base64 decoding the existing configuration file and then uploading the changes. For most cases, using the OpenShift Container Platform web console to make changes to the config.yaml file is simpler.
